Definition: another form of the base of G4458; an enclitic particle of indefiniteness; yet, even; used only in the compounds. See G3369, G3380, G3764, G3768, G4455.
BiblicalUsage: The particle -po never stands alone in the Greek New Testament. It is only the tail of other words — not yet, never yet — and no verse reads it by itself.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that even a word with no verse of its own tells me something: some pieces of language only live inside larger words.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
